description.en: Sells credits under the Step Plan. Step Plan international API with monthly Credits and top-up quota.
description.zh: 以 Step Plan 形式销售额度。 阶跃星辰 Step Plan 国际版 API，支持月度 Credits 与加购额度。

description.en: Add a Step API key and, optionally, a platform cookie for monthly Credits and top-up quota refresh.
description.zh: 填写 Step API 密钥，并可选补充平台 Cookie，用于刷新月度 Credits 与加购额度。

help_text.en: Optional. Paste the full cookie block from the Step Plan Subscribe page to refresh monthly Credits and top-up quota.
help_text.zh: 可选。从 Step Plan Subscribe 页面粘贴完整 Cookie，用于刷新月度 Credits 与加购额度。

title.zh: 连接阶跃星辰 Step Plan 国际版
